data.one_liner: Queue up futures from multiple sources and await their return anywhere in your code.
data.what_it_does: A central queue for executing futures in order and returning their results. It supports parallel execution limits, delays between tasks, LIFO processing, and cancellation.
use_when: You need to rate limit calls to external devices or APIs
You want to process multiple asynchronous tasks sequentially or with a parallel limit
avoid_when: You are managing complex reactive UI state where a stream controller or state management library is better suited
strengths: Supports parallel processing limits and rate-limiting delays
Allows adding items to the front of the queue
Provides completion and remaining item stream tracking
weaknesses: Cancelled queues throw exceptions and must be recreated rather than restarted
